{{Quote|Their ship will crash soon on Nal Hutta. Be there to capture the fugitives.|The pilot speaking to a Nikto guard|<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />}}
This '''[[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] pilot''' worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lords on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
After [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disguised as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], was abandoned on Nal Hutta by fellow prisoners [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], he was captured and brought to the Hutt Palace by a [[Unidentified Nikto guard (Nal Hutta)/Legends|Hutt enforcer]] who tortured him for information about the two other escapees.<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] willfully gave the guard the [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracker]]'s frequency code in exchange for being released and this pilot along with two others were immediately sent in [[HH-87 Starhopper/Legends|HH-87 starfighters]] to shoot down the prisoner's [[YV-666 light freighter]] ship. After the ship was damaged, the Nikto reported back to the enforcer who sent in reinforcements to capture the prisoners once the ship crashed.<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />
